name: Us and Them
source:
In the aftermath of war, 1950s Korean journalist Jinsol Jeon struggles to find reason to live after the murder of her mentor. As a result, our protagonist's two conflicting desires reflect on their host’s memories.

[From [url=https://xander1230.itch.io/us-and-them]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
战争结束后，20世纪50年代的韩国记者全真松 (Jinsol Jeon) 在导师被谋杀后努力寻找生存的理由。结果，我们的主人公的两种相互冲突的欲望反映在主人的记忆中。

[来自[url=https://xander1230.itch.io/us-and-them]Itch.io[/url]]
